articles.title: Sikar Tragedy: Woman and Four Children Found Dead; Families Refuse to Claim Bodies
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sikar (Rajasthan): A heartbreaking case of mass suicide has come to light from Anirudh Residency, Palwas Road, where five members of a family — a mother and her four children — were found dead inside a flat after reportedly consuming poison.

body.html:
Sikar (Rajasthan): A heartbreaking case of mass suicide has come to light from Anirudh Residency, Palwas Road, where five members of a family — a mother and her four children — were found dead inside a flat after reportedly consuming poison.

The deceased have been identified as Kiran Devi alias Pinky (40), her sons Sumit (18), Ayu (4), Avnish (2.5), and daughter Sneha (13). Their decomposed bodies were discovered after neighbors complained of a foul smell coming from the locked apartment for over a week.

Police recovered ten packets of poison (eight used) and a bottle of liquid poison from the scene. Preliminary investigations suggest the family consumed poisoned food. Samples of the food and other items have been sent for forensic testing.

According to police, Kiran was active on social media, making YouTube comedy videos and Instagram reels featuring her children. Her daughter Sneha also posted gaming clips online.

Kiran’s personal life had been turbulent. She first eloped and married Nemichand from her village in 2006, with whom she had two children. The couple divorced in 2019, after which Kiran married Shailesh, a teacher from Jhunjhunu, and had two sons.
Last year, Kiran filed a rape case against Shailesh, which was later found false during the police investigation. Since then, she had been living alone with her children.

Following the discovery of the bodies, neither her parents nor her two husbands came forward to claim them. Police said both families refused to perform the last rites, forcing them to proceed with the postmortem independently.

Sadar Police Station in-charge Indraraj Marodia stated, “Since both families have refused to claim the bodies, the police will conduct the postmortem and handle further procedures.”

The cause behind the extreme step remains unclear, and the investigation continues.

articles.title: Muzaffarnagar Shock: Hindu Man Attacked Over Interfaith Love Marriage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Muzaffarnagar (Uttar Pradesh): A sensational incident has emerged from Jasoi village under Titavi police station, where 26-year-old Suraj Thakur and his brother were attacked with sticks and rods over a love marriage with a Muslim woman.

body.html:
Muzaffarnagar (Uttar Pradesh): A sensational incident has emerged from Jasoi village under Titavi police station, where 26-year-old Suraj Thakur and his brother were attacked with sticks and rods over a love marriage with a Muslim woman. The victims were seriously injured and admitted to hospital, with Suraj later referred to Meerut for treatment.

Suraj, a resident of Nagla Pithoura village, had married Arshi, daughter of Dr. Naseem, in a court ceremony about a year and a half ago, defying her family’s opposition. The couple has a daughter. Tensions had reportedly been ongoing between the two families due to the interfaith marriage.

On Saturday (October 11, 2025), a gang of four people allegedly attacked Suraj near a local shop in Jasoi. The assault was captured on CCTV cameras and has since gone viral, sparking outrage in the district.

Following the attack, Pinky Thakur, Suraj’s mother, filed an FIR against Naseem Alvi, Wakar, Naeem, Kayyum, and Kaif. Police have arrested Naseem Alvi, Wakar, and Naeem, while Kayyum remains absconding. Investigations are ongoing.

The incident has drawn widespread attention, with Swami Yashveer Maharaj warning that the Sanatan Samaj may hold a public protest outside the accused’s homes if action is not taken swiftly.

SSP Sanjay Kumar Verma confirmed the case has been registered under serious sections and said police teams are actively conducting raids to apprehend the remaining accused.

articles.title: Tantric Ritual Horror in Meerut: Men Caught Removing Skull from Burning Pyre, Cooking Rice Nearby
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut (Uttar Pradesh): A shocking incident from Ajrada village under Mundali police station limits has left locals horrified.

body.html:
Meerut (Uttar Pradesh): A shocking incident from Ajrada village under Mundali police station limits has left locals horrified. Two men were caught allegedly performing tantric rituals at a cremation ground late Friday night — removing body parts from a burning pyre and cooking rice nearby.

The deceased being cremated was Gajendra (32), a Dalit youth who was murdered in Delhi. His last rites had been performed earlier that evening.

Around 11 p.m., villagers operating a tube well noticed suspicious activity near the pyre. They found three men removing the skull and cooking rice over the fire. Enraged, villagers thrashed the accused before police arrived and rescued them. One man escaped.

Police later arrested two accused — Baljeet and Imran — and sent them to jail. Locals allege that the same men may have earlier dug up graves in the nearby cemetery. Investigations are underway to determine their motive and possible links to Gajendra’s murder.

articles.title: Imam’s Wife and Two Daughters Found Hacked to Death in Uttar Pradesh’s Baghpat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Baghpat (Uttar Pradesh): A horrifying crime has shocked Gangnauli village in the Doghat police station area, where the wife and two young daughters of a mosque’s imam were brutally murdered inside the mosque premises on Saturday afternoon.

body.html:
Baghpat (Uttar Pradesh): A horrifying crime has shocked Gangnauli village in the Doghat police station area, where the wife and two young daughters of a mosque’s imam were brutally murdered inside the mosque premises on Saturday afternoon.

According to police, the victims — Irsana (30), her five-year-old daughter Sofia, and two-year-old daughter Sumaiya — were found lying in a pool of blood inside the Imam’s residence attached to the Big Mosque. Preliminary investigation suggests they were hacked to death with a sharp weapon.

At the time of the murder, Imam Ibrahim, originally from Sunna village in Muzaffarnagar, had gone to Deoband. Locals said Irsana used to teach neighborhood children at her home inside the mosque compound.

The crime came to light around 3 p.m., when children who had come for tuition discovered the bodies and alerted adults nearby. Police teams soon reached the spot, but tension erupted as angry villagers clashed with officers while they attempted to remove the bodies.

DIG Meerut Kalanidhi Naithani and Superintendent of Police Suraj Kumar Rai visited the scene. The DIG has formed special investigation teams to probe the triple murder from all possible angles.

The bodies have been sent for post-mortem examination, and forensic teams are collecting evidence from the crime scene. Police said the motive behind the killings is not yet clear, but every possible lead is being explored.

The brutal murder of the Imam’s family has left the local community in shock, raising serious concerns about safety even in places of worship.

articles.title: Bhopal Shock: 22-Year-Old BTech Student Dies After Alleged Police Beating
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): A 22-year-old BTech student, Udit Gaayke, died after he was allegedly beaten by police personnel in Bhopal early Friday, triggering widespread anger after a video of the assault surfaced online.

body.html:
Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): A 22-year-old BTech student, Udit Gaayke, died after he was allegedly beaten by police personnel in Bhopal early Friday, triggering widespread anger after a video of the assault surfaced online.

The footage shows one policeman restraining Udit while another repeatedly strikes him with a stick. The incident reportedly took place around 1:30 am in Indrapuri, when Udit, who had been partying with friends, ran into a lane upon seeing police. He was then chased and brutally assaulted by two constables.

According to DCP (Zone 2) Vivek Singh, the accused policemen — constables Santosh Bamaniya and Saurabh Arya — have been suspended, and further action will follow after the post-mortem report is received.

Udit’s friends said he was taken to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival. They also alleged that the policemen demanded ₹10,000 to stop the assault. His body bore visible bruises, and his shirt was torn, they claimed.

Authorities have stated that the case is being investigated by a City Superintendent of Police (CSP)-level officer, and statements from family members are being recorded.

Officials confirmed that Udit’s parents live in Bhopal, while his brother-in-law serves as a DSP in Balaghat district.

The shocking incident has raised serious questions about police brutality and misuse of power in the state.

articles.title: Man Caught on CCTV Molesting Woman’s Body During Post-Mortem at Madhya Pradesh Hospital
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Burhanpur (Madhya Pradesh): In a disturbing revelation, CCTV footage from the Khaknar Community Health Centre in Burhanpur district has exposed a year-old incident in which a man was seen molesting the body of a woman kept for post-mortem.

body.html:
Burhanpur (Madhya Pradesh): In a disturbing revelation, CCTV footage from the Khaknar Community Health Centre in Burhanpur district has exposed a year-old incident in which a man was seen molesting the body of a woman kept for post-mortem.

Police identified the accused as Nilesh Bhilala (25), a resident of Tangiyapat village in Bhouraghat area, who has now been arrested.

According to Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP) Antar Singh Kanesh, the footage surfaced online recently, following which Dr. Adya Dawar, a medical officer at the centre, filed a written complaint on October 7, 2025.

A preliminary probe revealed that the shocking act occurred on April 18, 2024, around 6:45 am. Based on the complaint, the Khaknar Police registered a case under Section 297 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) for the insult to human corpses.

Acting under the directions of Superintendent of Police Devendra Patidar and Sub-Divisional Officer (Police) Nirbhay Singh Alawa, a team led by Station House Officer Abhishek Jadhav tracked down the accused. During interrogation, Bhilala confessed to the crime and was produced before a local court in Burhanpur.

Officials said the investigation is ongoing to determine how the accused gained access to the post-mortem section of the health centre.

The incident has triggered public outrage and renewed questions about security lapses and moral decay in sensitive medical facilities.

body.html:
Nanded (Maharashtra): A shocking incident from Nanded has gone viral after CCTV footage captured a woman and her brother brutally assaulting her husband over a family property dispute.

According to reports, the fight began when the woman demanded her share in the ancestral property, which her husband and mother-in-law allegedly refused to divide. Following a heated argument, the wife pretended to faint outside the house, claiming she had been beaten and was unable to walk.

Moments later, her brother arrived and launched a violent attack on the husband. Shockingly, the woman — who had just been pretending to be unconscious — suddenly stood up and joined her brother in beating her husband mercilessly.

The husband sustained a serious head injury during the assault and was heard screaming in pain in the footage. The wife and her brother continued the attack without showing any remorse.

The entire incident was caught on CCTV, and the video has since spread widely on social media, sparking outrage. Police have registered a case and are investigating the matter.

Locals have condemned the incident, calling it a disturbing example of domestic violence and greed-driven cruelty.

body.html:
Jaipur (Rajasthan): A shocking incident from the state capital has sparked outrage after a CCTV video showing a man molesting a woman outside a crowded sweet shop went viral on social media.

The incident occurred on Sunday evening outside the well-known Rajasthan Mishthan Bhandar. In the footage, the accused — identified as Gautam — can be seen groping a woman’s breast as she stepped out of the shop, leaving her stunned and distressed.

According to reports, Gautam had earlier attempted to inappropriately touch the woman at the counter, but when she resisted, he followed her outside and assaulted her.

The woman immediately raised an alarm, drawing the attention of nearby customers. Enraged locals caught hold of the accused, beat him up, and handed him over to the police.

Police have confirmed that a case has been registered against Gautam under POCSO and relevant sections of harassment laws.

The incident has triggered public outrage, with residents calling for stricter action against such offenders and questioning the safety of women in public spaces. The shop owner has assured authorities that additional security measures will be implemented to prevent such incidents in the future.

articles.title: Love, Blackmail and Tragedy: ASI Dismissed After 2022 Indore Police Shooting Scandal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Indore (Madhya Pradesh): A sensational case from 2022 outside the Indore Police Control Room involving a love affair, blackmail, and greed has finally concluded with the dismissal of ASI Ranjana Khande from service.

body.html:
Indore (Madhya Pradesh): A sensational case from 2022 outside the Indore Police Control Room involving a love affair, blackmail, and greed has finally concluded with the dismissal of ASI Ranjana Khande from service.

The case dates back to 2022 when TI Hakam Singh Pawar of Bhopal’s Shyamala Hills police station was having coffee with ASI Ranjana Khande at the Indore Control Room premises. A dispute erupted between the two, during which TI Pawar fired a shot at Ranjana with his service revolver. The first shot grazed her ear, causing her to faint. Believing she was dead, Pawar then shot himself, leading to a tragic scene.

Police initially thought a third party had attacked them, but the TI’s revolver was found nearby, and once Ranjana regained consciousness, the matter was handed over to a Special Investigation Team (SIT).

The SIT probe revealed shocking details: TI Pawar and ASI Khande were involved in a love affair, despite Pawar being married three times. Ranjana Khande was allegedly blackmailing Pawar, demanding money, a bungalow, and luxuries. She reportedly possessed pornographic videos of Pawar, which she used for extortion. The dispute escalated in Indore, culminating in the shooting incident.

A case of abetment to suicide (Section 306 IPC) was registered against TI Pawar, and the trial is currently pending. Meanwhile, a departmental inquiry against Ranjana Khande confirmed the allegations of misconduct. Initially, she faced a one-year pay freeze, but after review, authorities deemed the punishment insufficient for the severity of her actions. Consequently, ASI Ranjana Khande has now been dismissed from service.

The case remains a cautionary tale of personal misconduct within the police force and its tragic consequences.
